description: One mapping row for the Payment Router. Sets target[target_fieldname] = static_value when Static is checked, otherwise to the value of source_fieldname on the Salis Payment Request.

fields.description: Fieldname on the TARGET payment DocType to populate (for example party, paid_amount, posting_date).
fields.label: Target Fieldname

fields.description: Fieldname on the Salis Payment Request to copy FROM (for example amount, supplier, company, cost_center). Ignored when Static is checked.
fields.label: Source Fieldname (Salis Payment Request)

fields.description: When checked, the target field is set to the constant Static Value instead of copying from the request.
fields.label: Static

fields.description: Constant value written to the target field when Static is checked (for example a fixed payment_type or party_type).
fields.label: Static Value

name: Payment Routing Field Map
